faq.title: Do you have questions?
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions by our users.
faq.q1: How do I find housing on Eyang Estate?
faq.a1: Browse our listings, filter by your criteria (wifi, generator, water, budget) and send a request directly to the landlord.
faq.a2: Yes, every listing is inspected by our team before being published.
faq.q3: How does the booking system work?
faq.a3: Once your account is created, send a booking request. The landlord responds within 24 hours.
faq.q4: I'm a landlord, how do I list my property?
faq.a4: Create an Owner account and fill in your property details from your dashboard.
faq.a5: For students, the platform is completely free.
faq.a6: Via the Contact page, by email or through the integrated messaging. Our team responds within 2 hours on weekdays.
